summary: Frontend-only verification of new Combo Selector (Ne almak istiyorsunuz?) on wizard Step 4 (index 3) and pre-submit Bank Transfer info panel. ALL 10 acceptance criteria PASSED. Full wizard walkthrough with 1 adult TEST traveler, 30-Day Single Entry visa (5.190₺), trip 01.03.2026->10.03.2026 (9 gün). On Step 4 combo-selector renders with 4 options (combo-option-visa, combo-option-visa_esim, combo-option-visa_ins, combo-option-visa_all). Totals observed: visa=5.190₺ (no bundle row), visa_esim=5.930₺ (5190+740 esim_3gb, no bundle row), visa_ins=5.750₺ (5190+560 ins_15d, no bundle row), visa_all=6.360₺ (5190+560+740-130 bundle) with data-testid=summary-bundle-discount visible only for visa_all. Active combo card correctly gets border-primary highlight after each click. extras-quick-add panel stays mounted so quick-* rows sync with combo picks. Payment method: on payment-method-card, bank-transfer-info NOT rendered (count=0); on payment-method-transfer BEFORE submit, bank-transfer-info renders with bank-account-name='VizeAtlas Turizm ve Danışmanlık A.Ş.', bank-name='Örnek Bank A.Ş.', bank-iban='TR00 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 00', bank-amount='6.360 ₺', and bank-agency-info block present. Clicking 'Havale bilgilerini al' fires POST /api/applications -> 200, reference_code=DV-NC941982, after which pre-submit bank-transfer-info is replaced by bank-transfer-details block containing same 6.360₺ Tutar (matches summary-total-price).
critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is now 2182 lines; the growing wizard should be extracted into StepPeople/StepVisa/StepDocs/StepSummary sub-components with a shared useApplyState hook.

ComboSelector activeId falls back to undefined when the current picks (e.g., insurance yes + esim no) do not match any of the 4 pre-defined OPTIONS. This is fine today because the OPTIONS cover all boolean combinations, but if a user manually toggles only insurance-off keeping eSIM on, then adds insurance from a different section, activeId will still map to visa_all. Consider indicating 'Özel seçim' state when picks don't cleanly match a combo.

applyCombo() uses recommendedInsuranceId/recommendedEsimId if present, otherwise first product. For eSIM the first product is esim_1gb (440₺) but the observed run picked esim_3gb (740₺) via the recommendation — this makes 'Sadece vize + eSIM' more expensive than the minimum. Consider adding a subtle info line 'Önerilen paket seçildi — istediğiniz an değiştirin.' beside the combo card.
